dimensions.assessment: Affects federal Department of Justice officials and state and local governments permitting certain types of pretrial release.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter, the Attorney General shall make publicly available a list of each State and unit of local government

dimensions.assessment: Creates a public reporting mandate for government entities rather than altering direct legal penalties for individuals.
dimensions.evidence: make publicly available a list of each State and unit of local government that permits the release pending trial

dimensions.assessment: The provided text does not state specific appropriations or fiscal costs.
Imposes a new annual reporting requirement on the Attorney General regarding specific state and local criminal justice practices.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Attorney General to make publicly available a list of each State and unit of local government that permits cashless bail

dimensions.assessment: Ongoing, permanent annual reporting requirements starting not later than one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary authorizations for carrying out the reporting.
Details on how data collection will be funded at the state and local levels.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes reporting requirements for the Department of Justice regarding state and local governments that permit cashless bail for certain offenses, affecting federal reporting processes and state and local jurisdictions.
